chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'How is the camel slaughtered?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'It is slaughtered while it is standing, from the right side.'

key_terms.الْبَدَنَةُ: the camel (specifically one used for sacrifice or pilgrimage)

ai.seo_question: How should a camel be slaughtered according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the physical posture and anatomical orientation for slaughtering a camel, specifying that it should be slaughtered while standing and from the right side. This ruling reflects the practical jurisprudence of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), distinguishing camel slaughter from other livestock and emphasizing the importance of following the Prophet's tradition in ritual purity and method.
